name: showTags
label: Show Tags
description: Option to indicate that tags should be enabled

name: tagEditorIsVisible
label: Tag panel is visible
description: Allows custom tag editor to hide / show (Not part of the component only used for UIB UI only)

name: tagsDataSource
label: Data source
description: How the data for tags will be provided

name: availableTags
label: Tag List
description: List of visible tags for activity stream

name: title
label: Title
description: Title of the activity stream

name: appId
label: App Id
description: Identifier used to separate some of the stored data to prevent conflicts across multiple workspaces using the same records, please bind to @context.app.appId

name: table
label: Table
description: Name of the record where the activity stream will be displayed

name: sysId
label: Sys ID
description: The alphanumeric combination used to identify the record

name: view
label: Workspace view
description: Selection for form or layout view; must be configured to enable activity stream events

name: isNewRecord
label: New record
description: Option to indicate that the record is new

name: extraParams
label: Extra parameters
description: Extra parameters to pass to the activity stream from the Form Controller

name: showConversationFilter
label: Show conversation filter
description: Option to display the activity stream conversation filter

name: showEmailLink
label: Show email link
description: Option to enable the email link in contact cards

name: showPhoneLink
label: Show phone link
description: Option to enable the phone link in contact cards

name: showTileAvatars
label: Show avatars
description: Displays avatars in the activity stream

name: showTileIcons
label: Show tile icons
description: Displays tile icons in the activity stream

name: events
label: Events
description: List of events to be displayed in the activity stream

name: supplemental
label: Supplemental
description: Supplemental data for activity stream events, such as flags, favorites, and pins

name: fields
label: Fields
description: Used to read field level information, such as dictionary attributes, definition, and field state. The Tiles use this information to read configurations

name: recordMembers
label: Record members
description: Array of objects with shape { sys_id, name } used to pre-populate mentions when editing journal fields

name: ambChannels
label: AMB Channels
description: Array of AMB channels to connect to; they enable real-time updates as new events are created

name: userReferences
label: User references
description: Array of user information to reuse across events

name: featureFlags
label: Feature flags
description: Array of feature flags in the format {name: 'name', value: 'value'}

name: filterOptions
label: Filter options
description: Array of filter options in the format {isSelected: true, label: 'Filter label', name: 'name'}

name: timestamp
label: Timestamp
description: Current timestamp, used to determine when new data is sent

name: suppressPreviewRecordForEmailActions
label: Suppress preview record for email actions
description: Stops propagation of the "preview record" and "email action requested" events for email actions

name: userSession
label: User session information
description: Object containing the user session information

name: bare
label: Bare
description: Removes padding around the activity stream component

name: showEmailOptions
label: Show Email Options
description: Enable email features

name: showNewActivityMarker
label: Show New Activity Marker
description: Enable new activity marker

name: showEmailCompactHeader
label: Show Email Compact Header
description: Enable compact header for email tiles

name: enableEmailShowFullConversation
label: Enable Email Show Full Conversation
description: Enable to hide/view full thread of conversation for all emails.

name: enableLineSeparator
label: Enable Line Separator
description: Enables line separator

name: suppressGlobalEvents
label: Suppress global events
description: Suppress events that rely on parent elements handling, and only dispatch events with the component prefix that are manually binded

name: attachmentTileComponent
label: Attachment tile component
description: Overwrite component used to render attachment tiles

name: auditTileComponent
label: Audit tile component
description: Overwrite component used to render audit tiles

name: auditRelationTileComponent
label: Audit relation tile component
description: Overwrite component used to render audit relation tiles

name: emailTileComponent
label: Email tile component
description: Overwrite component used to render email tiles

name: journalTileComponent
label: Journal tile component
description: Overwrite component used to render journal tiles

name: refreshRequested
label: Refresh requested
description: Timestamp of activity refresh request

name: enableEditDelete
label: Enable edit and delete of journal posts
description: Option to enable editing and deleting of journal posts in the activity stream

name: forceSortDirection
label: Force sort direction
description: Controls the sort direction for the activity stream. If set to a value other than 'Default', a fixed sort direction will be applied and the sort button will be disabled.
